105:t_2:67.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's not what I meant...!」

105:t_2:68.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What I expect from you isn't that. It's your tenacity when it comes to surviving.」

105:t_2:70.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Out in the world they used to call me Immortal $$コーラサワー$$, but even I don't believe there's such a thing as immortal or invincible.」

105:t_2:71.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But I didn't make it this far on good luck alone. I'm alive because I decided to live.」

105:t_2:74.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You've got the same smell about you that I do. So... hang in there.」

105:t_2:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...So both $$刹那$$ and $n are changing through their dealings with other people.」

105:t_2:77.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. And it's not only true of individuals.」

105:t_2:78.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You mean all of humanity will change?」

105:t_2:80.en:
$$アムロ$$
(For that very reason, I can't let the Earth... humanity... come to an end...)

105:t_2:81.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, please come up to the bridge right away.」

105:t_2:83.en:
$$ミコット$$
「It's a message from Commander $$ブライト$$. A $$ネオ・ジオン$$ force has apparently dropped into North America.」

105:t_2:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the day has finally come...」

105:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(...I thought you had only just come down to Earth, and straight into battle already. As always, your knack for drawing in trouble amazes me.)

105:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(On top of that, you wiped out the entire escort force... Even I, $$ＡＧ$$, was quite surprised.)

105:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Everyone's high morale produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

105:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(However, I can't believe the strength of the $$新地球皇国$$ is only this much. Please be careful...)

105:t_10:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Did you stock up the liquor I asked for?」

105:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-yes... well... Seeing as it's a request from none other than Miss $$スメラギ$$.」

105:t_10:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I feel like having a drink today. Will you bring it out?」

105:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is it to take your mind off the threat of the $$サイデリアル$$ and the fear of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ invasion?」

105:t_10:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's something all of $c will think over together. My drink is much more personal.」

105:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand. Miss $$スメラギ$$ is at that age, after all.」

105:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A schoolmate who made a happy marriage... Her husband is a bit airheaded, but he's a good-natured ace pilot who's crazy about her.」

105:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, no wonder you can't get through it without a drink. Allow me to make this bottle a treat from yours truly.」

105:t_10:21.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The truth is, it's been so long since I was last on Earth that I only meant to toast with the moon as my snack...)

105:t_10:22.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Since I've got the chance, maybe I'll indulge $$ＡＧ$$'s misunderstanding this time...)

105:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Listen, Miss $$スメラギ$$? No matter how sad you are, the night always ends. Keep your heart strong and live on with a smile.」

105:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, here we go! Let's give it our all again today...」

105:t_10:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$... It may have been a little off the mark, but that thought alone is enough for me.)

105:t_10:28.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Even someone like me has someone who cares about me... That alone warms my heart.)

106:t_000:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn $$サイデリアル$$! I won't let you run wild any longer!」

106:t_001:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn! I came to the rescue, but are we the ones in worse trouble!?」

106:t_001:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Lieutenant $$パトリック$$! At this rate...!」

106:t_001:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't worry! The Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General has asked for reinforcements!」

106:t_001:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Looks like we made it in time! Look!」

106:t_002:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Been waiting for you, $c!」

106:t_002:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「So that's the unit that was called the $$連邦軍$$'s strongest...!」

106:t_002:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Exactly. And for the record, I used to be one of them.」

106:t_002:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So that's how it is! Leave the rest to us and fall back, all of you!」

106:t_002:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「The war with the Empire keeps going back and forth. Don't misjudge where to put your lives on the line.」

106:t_002:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Besides, you know what I used to be called, right?」

106:t_002:8.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Feel better now? ...Stand by around here until I give the order.」

106:t_002:9.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Understood! We wish you the best of luck!」

106:t_003:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「All right... Let's do this, $c!」

106:t_004:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Long time no see, $n! But if you're going to be my partner, call me properly!」

106:t_004:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Now that's the spirit! And it lured the main event out, too!」

106:t_005:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$ must be planning to abduct the citizens of that city on the $$レイライン$$.」

106:t_005:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch...! Those guys are kidnapping people here, too!」

106:t_005:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, deploy! Break through the escort force and stop the transports!」

106:t_005:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Wait, please! Something else is still coming out!」

106:t_006:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So you were alive after all, $c.」

106:t_006:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're the $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ we met in Japan...!」

106:t_006:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You're unfortunate as well. You went to the trouble of picking up your lives from the $$時空震動$$, only to scatter them in a place like this.」

106:t_006:3.en:
$n
「Don't decide where our lives end up on your own.」

106:t_006:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you going to do with the people you kidnap!」

106:t_006:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...All ships, set course north. The escort force will take on $c.」

106:t_006:6.en:
$$カツ$$
「So you're saying you won't answer!」

106:t_006:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Answer? My $$バン・アルデバル$$ will give you one.」

106:t_006:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think this ship is the same as the $$アドラティオ$$. I'll teach you your place.」

106:t_006:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Be careful. The pressure really is different from when we fought in Japan.」
